howToKeepThisCurrent: This file is the single source of truth for GET /api/v1/migration/roadmap (see MigrationRoadmapProvider.cs). It is domain-grained (one entry per product domain), not task-grained -- for per-slice code-completion detail see agentic-migration.manifest.json. Update ONE entry whenever a domain's real-world status changes: (1) status changes when a domain's .NET port is code-complete/in-progress/deferred; (2) liveInProd flips only once its FORMMAPS_ROUTE_*_TO_DOTNET flag(s) are verified serving real production traffic (a Vercel env flip + confirmed canary/curl check), NOT just merged to main -- git history under-counts prod state because the live frontend deploys via direct `vercel --prod`, not a merge gate. Bump lastVerified on the entry and lastUpdated at the top of this file. Reference this file in the commit that completes or cuts over a domain, e.g. `docs(migration): mark <domain> live in domain-status manifest`.
